components.explanation: shaders/hurt_flash.gdshader, typed by Zhaohui: a canvas_item shader with two uniforms (hurt_amount, flash_color) and the colour line mix(COLOR.rgb, flash_color.rgb, hurt_amount).

fighter/hurt_flash.gd, written by Claude: a node under each fighter's Sprite2D that builds its own ShaderMaterial and sets hurt_amount = stun / HITSTUN every physics tick, after main.gd steps the fight; fighter.tscn adds the node.

tests/test_hurt_flash.gd drives the real loop with the J key and checks the uniform list, defaults from source and rules 1-6 at 30/60/144 fps; tests/capture_a5.gd makes the windowed in-engine captures.

shaders/granite.gdshader, typed by Zhaohui (colour texture with source_color, roughness and normal map as data, four uniforms in two groups); props3d/materials/*.tres from props3d/make_granite_materials.gd; the floor and StonePlinth in prop_room.tscn; the Poly Haven textures with explicit .import settings and ATTRIBUTION.md.

tests/test_materials.gd pins the audit (MATERIALS.md): shader paths, hints from source, material values, .import settings and curl ratios; tests/normal_map_check.gd (from the handout) and tests/calibrate_normal_map.gd check the normal map.

shaders/hint_experiment.gdshader, typed by Zhaohui: two samplers on one 3 x 1 grey PNG, with and without source_color, picked by a bool on unshaded quads; the scene, its two materials, and the scripts that write the PNG and the materials.
shaders/standard_generated.gdshader: Godot's own code for a StandardMaterial3D with the granite textures, converted in the editor by Zhaohui; nothing in the game uses it.

excerpts.text:
func _ready() -> void:
	# main.gd steps the fighters at the default priority 0; a higher value runs after it, so the
	# value set here is the one for the state of this same tick.
	process_physics_priority = 100
	material = ShaderMaterial.new()
	material.shader = SHADER
	sprite.material = material


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	var amount := 0.0
	if fighter.state == "hurt":
		amount = float(fighter.stun) / float(Fighter.HITSTUN)
	material.set_shader_parameter("hurt_amount", amount)
